name: Margin inflection
summary: Profitable companies whose operating margin rose 20+ percentage points in a year while revenue grew.
how_to_read: Three filters must all pass: operating margin up at least 20 percentage points on a year earlier (TTM vs the TTM a year before), revenue growth above zero, and an operating margin above zero today. The question each match raises: is the margin gain lasting (pricing, scale, a better mix) or one-off (a gain on a sale, a cost that moved quarters, a weak year-ago comparison)? Check the filings for one-off items before reading a trend into it.
misses: Inflections that haven't yet reached a full trailing year.
Companies still loss-making but improving fast.
